name: Saiyuu Shakuyaku Den Joukan
source:
Main character is an extraordinary monk who loves plotting, adultery and slaughter. He flees the country from pursuers and goes on a journey to a certain mountain. His adventure is going to be anything but boring.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-january-2006-io.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名与众不同的僧人，热衷于阴谋、通奸与杀戮。为了躲避追捕，他逃离自己的国家，踏上前往某座山的旅程。他的冒险，注定不会无聊。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-january-2006-io.html]vndbreview[/url]]
